description_en: You can invoke ModifyPhoneNumber to modify the information of a specified phone number under a specified instance, primarily to update the number's usage and the attached contact flow ID
description_zh: 调用ModifyPhoneNumber修改指定实例下指定号码的信息，主要是修改号码用途和绑定的联系流ID
kebab_example: aliyun ccc modify-phone-number --instance-id ccc-test --number 01021340000 --usage Bidirection --contact-flow-id 78128960-bb00-4ddc-8a82-923a8c5bd22d --api-version 2020-07-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyPhoneNumber

parameters.description_en: The IVR contact flow ID attached to the number. This field is valid only when the number usage is Inbound or Bidirection.
parameters.description_zh: 号码绑定的IVR联系流ID，仅在号码用途为Inbound或Bidirection时，该字段才有效。
parameters.help_en: The IVR contact flow ID attached to the number. This field is valid only when the number usage is Inbound or Bidirection
parameters.help_zh: 号码绑定的IVR联系流ID，仅在号码用途为Inbound或Bidirection时，该字段才有效
parameters.name: contact_flow_id
